visibleWhen: Core typed ReadAloudCardsProjection has pipeline=awaiting_card_resolution, attentionRequired=true and CardResolution is non-null.
fieldPolicy: Candidate occurrence segmentId/order/start/end/exactText/sourceSha256, decisionId and targetToken are copied from the typed Core projection; Desktop never computes occurrence identity.
submissionPolicy: All actions call CoreV3Client.ResolveCardResolutionAsync. Authorization remains inside the gateway ReadToAnkiOperationAuthorizationCoordinator and is absent from UI DTOs.
terminalPolicy: After accepted submission the old prompt is cleared and resolving is shown. Only the matching terminalCommandId with terminalSequence at or after acceptedSequence may project a new preview or terminal result. Failure and cancel release the Desktop busy lease.
